This is the A5 (Statistics) department paper — a DIFFERENT paper from the other JU A 2013-14 department papers of the same session; it must not be merged with them. The Drive listing label 'Set-5' is only the file's position in the Drive folder and DISAGREES with the printed code 1/2; the printed header governs. Following the D-unit precedent (ju-d2-2013-2014-set3), the paper id carries the printed sub-unit: ju-a5-2013-2014-set1-2, unit 'A5'. The PDF is a compiler-produced file (metadata: Creator 'SDG', produced with PDFelement 6 Professional, 2018-08-27) that reprints the paper with a boxed solved key after each question — 'উত্তরঃ X' (Bangla letters ক-ঘ) for the Bangla and Higher Mathematics questions, 'Ans: X' (Latin) for English Q9–15 — and NO ব্যাখ্যা. Subjects are assigned per question by content (no subject headings are printed): Bangla Q1–8 (8), English Q9–15 (7), Higher Mathematics Q16–60 (45). 60 questions: 58 keyed, 2 KEYLESS (Q2 — key box under the AdmissionWar watermark, letter not certainly readable; Q16 — no key box printed anywhere for it), 0 dual keys, 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions. A handwritten circled '১২' on the header is a reader mark, NOT a key, and was ignored. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification.
